question.html:
An electron gun is used to produce a narrow beam of electrons which enters a region of uniform magnetic field. The electrons follow a circular path in this magnetic field.

a State the direction of the force acting on an electron when it enters the magnetic field perpendicularly. [1]

b Write an equation for the magnetic force acting on a charged particle moving in a magnetic field. [1]

c Describe the path taken by the electron in the magnetic field and explain the cause of this motion. [2]

d Calculate the speed of an electron accelerated from rest through a potential difference of 4.0 kV. [2]

e Determine the radius of the circular path taken by the electron in a magnetic field of 0.30 T. [3]

f Suggest why a vacuum is necessary in the tube containing the electron beam. [1]
